You'll have to liberate the village to have reliable contact with the mainland, but if you liberate the whole island, it'll make a decent forward base. Besides, the locals will be grateful and may help you with information.

He's a very energetic and enduring young man. I adore those!

Now you're real defenders of your home!
I'm still not sure I did the right thing. And I'll never be sure. I... I miss him.
It's normal to grieve. Doesn't mean the decision was wrong.
Doing the right thing is one thing. Living with it is something else entirely.
That's why you still haven't taken down his body?
Justice sometimes requires sacrifices. I sympathize with your loss.
Sometimes when I see that hanged Herman, I get sad. Then I remember that because of that ferret I almost hanged old Luc.

The enemy of my enemy is my friend, thanks — here’s something for your help.
We noticed among the attackers fighters with the same equipment as yours...

We’ve had a disagreement here over views on the current situation. We’re smugglers, we have centralization, but opinions differ. After the Legion started taking over the country, some believed it’s the new authority now and that it’s better to establish contact with them right away — strike while the iron is hot.
column5: ModItemConversation ThugBalumba Text  section:ThugBalumba keyword:Мы заметили среди нападавших бойцов с такой же экипировкой, как у вас...

column2: Smugglers, huh? So can you arrange some interesting toys for us?

That won’t be a problem. We ended up stuck on the island, so we started supplying the local partisans. We’ve got enough money and we won’t gain much from small-scale trade, so we have a mutually beneficial offer for you.
column5: ModItemConversation ThugBalumba Text  section:ThugBalumba keyword:Контрабандисты, значит можете организовать нам какие-то интересные игрушки?

column2: Briefing

Below us is our backup camp. It so happened that our former friends became our enemies. We now call them khokhly because they’re filthy pigs. They sided with the Legion and there’s only one way out. Even if this all settles down, the Boss won’t forgive them, and we won’t be able to coexist anymore. So I propose a joint military operation: we clear out the enemy, and in return you can bargain with us for whatever we can offer — naturally at a discount.

Here’s the situation: a scout group is already not far from the camp. They’re well armed and have set up security, so here’s a bonus — as soon as you engage in battle, they’ll join in immediately. I selected experienced fighters for that.
column5: ModItemConversation ThugBalumba Text  section:ThugBalumba keyword:Мы согласны

column2: x
Not eager to get involved in the local criminal squabbles
Well gentlemen, then let’s part ways.
column5: ModItemConversation ThugBalumba Text  section:ThugBalumba keyword:Не охота вмешиваться в терки местного криминалитета

column2: Hello
The job is done, the camp is cleared.

Excellent, gentlemen. My scouts have already reported. Our turn now — I’ve ordered the fighters to make an exception for you. Various equipment is stored at the base; the prices for you will be quite pleasant.
column5: ModItemConversation ThugBalumba Text  section:ThugBalumba keyword:Дело сделано, лагерь зачищен

column2: We changed our minds
Excellent, so what have you decided?
column5: ModItemConversation ThugBalumba Text  section:ThugBalumba keyword:Мы передумали

column2: Until next time
Marx would be proud of you

Thank you for the help and for coordinating the base defense. The Legion is becoming more efficient; with each day the enemy grows stronger. They’re definitely being trained by some military professional, but we’ll deal with that too... I was also informed that you helped eliminate Rafael and his henchmen — thank you, you saved many lives. Here’s a little extra for you.
Good thing we arrived in time.
We need your help again. The scum have holed up in our bunker. From this base it’s practically impossible to enter it. We tried assaulting it but uselessly lost men... Good men.
column5: ModItemConversation L1_RebelsCamp Text  section:L1_RebelsCamp keyword:Хорошо, что мы прибыли вовремя

column2: Sure, why not play dungeon janitors while we’re at it.

Good. First of all, you need to reach sector L6, take control of it, then enter the bunker and begin clearing from there. They won’t expect it because that entrance was lost quite a while ago. We were stretched thin across different positions for a long time, during which the bunker was occupied. Our people may still be inside. If they managed to hold somewhere, it would be the headquarters room — you won’t miss it.
column5: ModItemConversation L1_RebelsCamp Text  section:L1_RebelsCamp keyword:Это можно, почему бы не поиграть заодно в санитаров подземелий

column2: Maybe you should take care of yourselves.
Maybe you’re right... I hope you change your mind.
column5: ModItemConversation L1_RebelsCamp Text  section:L1_RebelsCamp keyword:Возможно вам стоит самим о себе позаботиться.

column2: Hey comrades!
We solemnly return the bunker keys.
Not a single communist was harmed

We don’t have much else to offer you as a reward, but while you were down there, we intercepted a shipment of Legion diamonds. I don’t know what they were doing here with that case — probably planned to stash it on the island. Anyway, it’s yours.
column5: ModItemConversation L1_RebelsCamp Text  section:L1_RebelsCamp keyword:Торжественно вручаем обратно ключи от бункера.

column2: Good luck, comrades. You’re always welcome here.

Hello mercenaries, looks like you arrived just in time. We survived this attack, but I know the Legion won’t abandon their plans. Another attack is coming and we have time to prepare. We need to patch up the wounded, gather ammunition, and I’m running out of medical supplies, so please be so kind as to help me.
column5: ModItemConversation Ernie_LightHouse_DocLeevsy Text "Mala'dets" - meaning champion  section:Ernie_LightHouse_DocLeevsy keyword:Greeting

column2: Got enough of our own problems
Then get lost. I don’t have time for you anyway. If I see you again, we’ll open fire to kill.
column5: ModItemConversation Ernie_LightHouse_DocLeevsy Text  section:Ernie_LightHouse_DocLeevsy keyword:Своих забот полно док...

column2: Of course, we’ll help. That’s what we were hired for.

Money in the morning, chairs in the evening. We’ll talk after... So, by my calculations I need medical supplies, the more the better — overall 50 kits will do. Ammunition is also required; I know for sure there’s a stash of ammo beyond the bridge. Grab the mines too — they should be somewhere near the ruined metal hangar, hidden in ventilation. Also, collect the wounded before they bleed out. Get to work!
column5: ModItemConversation Ernie_LightHouse_DocLeevsy Text  section:Ernie_LightHouse_DocLeevsy keyword:Конечно, мы поможем, для этого нас и наняли.

column2: I take it you completed everything necessary. In gratitude, the guys prepared some goodies for you in the crates in the garage.
column5: ModItemConversation Ernie_LightHouse_DocLeevsy Text "I respect you"  section:Ernie_LightHouse_DocLeevsy keyword:Greeting3

column2: What did you do to anger the Legion so much?

You could have guessed — I’m a former soldier of fortune, like you. Without going into details, I have both military and medical training. When the Legion was just gaining momentum, I got many fighters back on their feet and made the Legion bleed a lot. I fought them, so I have scores to settle with many of their field commanders.
column5: ModItemConversation Ernie_LightHouse_DocLeevsy Text  section:Ernie_LightHouse_DocLeevsy keyword:Чем ты стал так не угоден Легиону?

column2: So now you’ll be able to patch us up when needed?
Of course — if we survive the Legion’s attack.
column5: ModItemConversation Ernie_LightHouse_DocLeevsy Text  section:Ernie_LightHouse_DocLeevsy keyword:Теперь ты сможешь подлатать нас по необходимости?

column2: So... We’re preparing for defense? We ran into a patrol while fetching ammo.

That’s correct, gentlemen. A fight awaits us. We’ll plant the mines right at the bridge — that’s our responsibility. We’ll also organize defense at key points on the map. We’re counting on your help. As usual, you don’t really have a choice right now.
column5: ModItemConversation Ernie_LightHouse_DocLeevsy Text  section:Ernie_LightHouse_DocLeevsy keyword:So... Are we preparing for defense? We ran into a patrol unit while we were fetching ammunition."

column2: Good, stick close to the locals. I don’t think we have much time left.
column5: ModItemConversation Ernie_LightHouse_DocLeevsy Text section:Ernie_LightHouse_DocLeevsy keyword:Мы готовы

column2: Looks like we made it! Thank you, mercenaries — you can always count on being welcome here.
Hello
We could use some patching up
Hope you’re not afraid of injections — I’ve got something for you.
column5: ModItemConversation Ernie_LightHouse_DocLeevsy Text section:Ernie_LightHouse_DocLeevsy keyword:Нас бы подлатать

column2: Until next time.
Hello

I never thought I’d be asking the war dogs of capital for help, but it seems the enemy of my enemy is my friend. We have no choice. I’ve got a bunch of wounded and exhausted fighters here, we’re almost out of ammo, and the weapons we managed to carry off — they’re barely weapons anymore...
What happened here?

Glad to hear you care about what’s happening. No time to tell it all from the beginning, but in short — the Legion multiplied and took over the whole country. Partisan cells are scattered across it. Ours tried to retake the island, but we were pushed out of our positions and now we’re forced to hole up here. I hope the others are doing better. You probably saw the bodies below. We’ve got almost nothing to shoot with. No medical supplies. We’re nearly out of food too.
column5: ModItemConversation Ernie_LegionCamp5_Rebels Text section:Ernie_LegionCamp5_Rebels keyword:Что тут случилось?

column2: So, what kind of help do you need?

As I said — we need weapons, ammo, and medical supplies. If you’re ready to clear out the Legion’s dogs, I’ll even give you fire support. But first... we need to save our fighter who should still be alive. He’s likely on the pier. Those dogs are about to execute him. He was covering the retreat from the second camp. Please save him.
column5: ModItemConversation Ernie_LegionCamp5_Rebels Text section:Ernie_LegionCamp5_Rebels keyword:Итак, какая помощь вам нужна

column2: We’re in
Hurry...
column5: ModItemConversation Ernie_LegionCamp5_Rebels Text section:Ernie_LegionCamp5_Rebels keyword:Мы берёмся

column2: No. Handle it yourselves.
A pity. Then go your own way and don’t get in ours.
column5: ModItemConversation Ernie_LegionCamp5_Rebels Text section:Ernie_LegionCamp5_Rebels keyword:Не, сами крутитесь.

column2: Thank you for saving our comrade.
Always happy to help
There’s one more matter, if you’re still willing to help.
column5: ModItemConversation Ernie_LegionCamp5_Rebels Text section:Ernie_LegionCamp5_Rebels keyword:Всегда пожалуйста

column2: Weapons?

Weapons. We need equipment from the old camp — there should also be medical supplies there. I have no one to send. The fighters are exhausted and wounded, the weapons are barely holding together. If something goes wrong there... well, our losses are already too heavy. And I hope you’ve got a sapper — we mined the approaches. Bring us the gear and I’ll find something to share with you.
We’re ready
Excellent.
column5: ModItemConversation Ernie_LegionCamp5_Rebels Text section:Ernie_LegionCamp5_Rebels keyword:Мы готовы

column2: Are we happy now?
That’s everything?
column5: ModItemConversation Ernie_LegionCamp5_Rebels Text section:Ernie_LegionCamp5_Rebels keyword:Мы счастливы?

column2: Yes

You’ve helped us greatly, thank you mercenaries. One of your colleagues in this dangerous business ended up with us — another soldier of fortune. I think he’ll gladly join you. At first he was rambling about some nonexistent country called Arulco, but that seems to have passed. He appears to have lost his memory, but definitely not his combat skills. He’s standing over there by the tents.
column5: ModItemConversation Ernie_LegionCamp5_Rebels Text section:Ernie_LegionCamp5_Rebels keyword:Да мы счастливы

column2: Ha-ha! What a day. Thought we’d fall under the paws of those jackals... turned out otherwise. Their blood is on the sand — and that’s partly thanks to you.

Didn’t expect to meet allies in this meat grinder. We didn’t expect to survive this fight. I am Comandante Kontimir Burda of the local partisan cell. We were tracking Rafael — cursed traitor, rat, idiot and thief — one of many Legion officers. At last the bastard found his death.
But tell me — who are you? Certainly not peasants. You don’t look like soldiers either. Some kind of elite commandos? Mercenaries, like those who came before you?
Greetings, mercenaries.
We’re mercenaries from AIM
I hope you’ll continue to stand on our side
column5: ModItemConversation Ernie_M1_Rebel_Briefing Text section:Ernie_M1_Rebel_Briefing keyword:Мы наемники из AIM

column2: We’re looking for Emma LaFontaine.
Emma is in sector K4
Emma? So that’s why you’re here... Yes, I know where she is. Brave girl — too brave for her age. She’s sheltering in the villa to the north. Sector K4.
column5: ModItemConversation Ernie_M1_Rebel_Briefing Text section:Ernie_M1_Rebel_Briefing keyword:Мы ищем Эмму Лафонтен.

column2: But reaching her now won’t be easy. The Legion has laid siege to the villa, surrounded it with squads and is waiting for the right moment to strike. If you want to reach her — you’ll have to break the ring.
column5: ModItemConversation Ernie_M1_Rebel_Briefing Text section:Ernie_M1_Rebel_Briefing keyword:Мы ищем Эмму Лафонтен.

column2: How many are there?
Several camps around the villa. They’re gathering forces to hit all at once.
column5: ModItemConversation Ernie_M1_Rebel_Briefing Text section:Ernie_M1_Rebel_Briefing keyword:Сколько их там?

column2: So if we clear them out beforehand, it’ll be easier to break through to Emma?
Leadership: you passed the check You need to clear the camps around the Villa
Moreover, disorganized Legion groups won’t be able to attack the villa as effectively, and you’ll deal with them easily.
column5: ModItemConversation Ernie_M1_Rebel_Briefing Text section:Ernie_M1_Rebel_Briefing keyword:Значит, если мы их предварительно зачистим, пробиться к Эмме будет проще?

column2: We sketched out a rough camp layout in , were preparing an assault. Look — secret spot here, guards here, there’s a passage here. You could sneak through at night and quietly take them out one by one. As for the other Legion camps — sorry, didn’t bring those plans. You’ll have to recon them yourselves. Scout the area. You can assign a couple of sharp people to the task — ones who won’t walk into an ambush.
column5: ModItemConversation Ernie_M1_Rebel_Briefing Text section:Ernie_M1_Rebel_Briefing keyword:Значит, если мы их предварительно зачистим, пробиться к Эмме будет проще?

column2: The situation in the region is complicated...

Complicated is an understatement. In short — our cell is cut off from the mainland. The Legion swept through the country in an instant. Ernie Island was the last stronghold of defense. The president’s daughter is hiding in the center of the island — they say that rat Corazon is with her. There’s also a smuggler base on the island. We can’t exactly call them friends, but they sell us weapons, and somehow we manage to coexist here. Overall, the Legion is everywhere. Some sectors still hold the line; others are completely occupied by the Red plague.
column5: ModItemConversation Ernie_M1_Rebel_Briefing Text section:Ernie_M1_Rebel_Briefing keyword:The situation in the region is complicated...

column2: So you’re fighting this "Legion"?

That’s right. The Legion enters our towns and villages like masters: they take supplies, intimidate and kill civilians, drain our mines. They turn the people’s labor into their personal loot. Rafael was just one of hundreds of these bastards. They’re like weeds — pull one out, and ten grow back tomorrow.
column5: ModItemConversation Ernie_M1_Rebel_Briefing Text  section:Ernie_M1_Rebel_Briefing keyword:So, you’re fighting this "Legion"?

column2: On behalf of the Maquis, the Rebels of Grand Chien, I call upon you to stand beside us in the fight against the Legion — and all who strangle shared ideals for power and profit. As for the reward, we’ll come to an agreement.
column5: ModItemConversation Ernie_M1_Rebel_Briefing Text  section:Ernie_M1_Rebel_Briefing keyword:So, you’re fighting this "Legion"?

column2: In that case, I invite you to our Camp in sector L1. Find me there or Comandante Kasongo — our leader here on the island.
column5: ModItemConversation Ernie_M1_Rebel_Briefing Text  section:Ernie_M1_Rebel_Briefing keyword:We agree

column2: No, find yourselves other fools.
A pity. Well, if you change your mind — I think we’ll meet again.
column5: ModItemConversation Ernie_M1_Rebel_Briefing Text  section:Ernie_M1_Rebel_Briefing keyword:No, find yourselves other fools.

column2: Good luck, mercenaries — and may the Force be with you.
Before us?
Yes, there was a gang of incompetents here. They arrived on the boat "Pride", sat in bars, claimed they were protecting us from the Legion. Then they sailed inland and no one saw them again.
column5: ModItemConversation Ernie_M1_Rebel_Briefing Text  section:Ernie_M1_Rebel_Briefing keyword:Before us?

column2: Ha... what a slaughter. Glad we’re on the same side.
My name is Diallo, but people usually call me Ghost.
Greeting

The sector is under our control.
Looks like they were unloading explosives here for an attack on the mansion.
Good job. I’ll put in a good word for you at the camp.
Here, take this. It’ll help you take down sentries at night.
We need help at the mansion
I can help with that. We’ll come to assist you if needed.
column5: ModItemConversation Rebels_Ghost Text  section:Rebels_Ghost keyword:We need help at the mansion

column2: What are you doing here?

Counting how many more men the Legion will lose before they realize someone in the jungle really doesn’t like them.
I wanted to intercept this squad, but you wiped out most of them first. Good job.
column5: ModItemConversation Rebels_Ghost Text  section:Rebels_Ghost keyword:What are you doing here?

column2: Judging by how you handled them, you could help me. Not far from here, north of the Waterfall, there’s a Lookout Point — one of the few places where the Legion unloads supplies for the island. If we attack it together, we can disrupt logistics in this part of the island.
column5: ModItemConversation Rebels_Ghost Text  section:Rebels_Ghost keyword:What are you doing here?

column2: We agree
Good. Then we’ll meet after the battle.
column5: ModItemConversation Rebels_Ghost Text  section:Rebels_Ghost keyword:We agree

column2: The waterfall?
Yes, further down the road there’s a waterfall. We’ll bypass it and wait for you at the Lookout Point.
column5: ModItemConversation Rebels_Ghost Text  section:Rebels_Ghost keyword:The waterfall?

column2: At the Waterfall along the river there’s a small Legion detachment — trying to cut off Burda’s unit. But the Legion doesn’t know there are several hidden mountain paths.
column5: ModItemConversation Rebels_Ghost Text  section:Rebels_Ghost keyword:The waterfall?

column2: Paths?
If I told you
We’ll manage on our own
A pity. Well, see you at the camp — if you make it there.
column5: ModItemConversation Rebels_Ghost Text  section:Rebels_Ghost keyword:We’ll manage on our own

column2: Goodbye
Good luck, mercenaries.
